_comment: Accepted npm audit advisories. Each needs a reason and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD); the gate fails once one expires.

exceptions.title: Next Vulnerable to Denial of Service with Server Components
exceptions.reason: Next 14.x receives no fixes for this; the fix exists only in Next 15.5.x/16.x. Tracked as P0-3 in docs/production-readiness.md (upgrade decision pending). Mitigations in place: no server actions, no next/image (image optimizer switched off), Linux hosting (Render).
